subject: Re: Northbridge SOC2 evidence - KMS & keystore handoff
messages:
From: Taylor Nguyen <security@northbridge.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-21T09:12:00Z
Subject: Northbridge SOC2 evidence request - KMS/HSM artifacts

Hi Connor,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 scoping for Redwood, our auditors need a compact evidence bundle for encryption and key management. Specifically: 1) recent key rotation logs (last 90 days) showing key lifecycle events; 2) HSM attestation (seal/cert) for the HSMs used for tenant KEK wrapping; 3) a minimal KMS config dump showing key aliases, key policies, and role bindings; and 4) an access matrix for engineers with key management privileges.

Can you provide a single package (or Drive link) with the artifacts above? We prefer CSV/Excel for logs and PDFs for attestation. If anything is sensitive, send via our secure upload link or let me know and we can set up a short SFTP.

-Taylor
Taylor Nguyen
Senior Security Engineer
Northbridge Financial

-----Original Message?-----
From: Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Nguyen <security@northbridge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-21T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Northbridge SOC2 evidence request - KMS/HSM artifacts

Hi Taylor — thanks for the clear list. We're assembling the artifacts now. Quick notes: 
- Rotation logs: we'll export the last 120 days to ensure coverage around any rollover dates.
- HSM attestation: we have the vendor-signed seal PDF dated 2028-06-30.
- KMS config: we'll include key aliases and the service-account role bindings; we'll redact tenant-specific ARNs.
- Access matrix: internal RBAC + IAM role mapping.

I'll route the package through Marissa (Security Ops) for redaction checks and send either a Drive link or SFTP instructions depending on your preference. If Northbridge needs the artifacts uploaded directly to your secure intake, send the link and we'll push.

Connor Obrien
Sr. Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-22T08:45:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Northbridge SOC2 evidence request - KMS/HSM artifacts

Connor / Neha — I'm prepping the ZIP. Draft inventory below; please confirm before I send to Taylor: 

Inventory (candidate files):
- redwood-kms-rotation-log-2028-07-20.csv (columns: timestamp, key_id, event_type, actor, request_id)
- hsm-attestation-seal-2028-07.pdf (vendor-signed attestation + certificate chain)
- kms-config-dump-20280720.txt (key aliases, creation dates, admin principal ARNs - redacted)
- access-matrix-20280720.xlsx (role, principal, scope, last_reviewed)

Redaction rules applied: no tenant PII, tenant ARNs replaced with <TENANT_REDACTED>, full SSH key material excluded. Audit logs maintain unique request_id for traceability.

Plan: run one last rotation-log sanity check on Monday morning (July 23) and then upload to our secure evidence Drive folder and share a view-only link to Taylor. If Northbridge prefers SFTP, we can push instead.

Marissa
Security Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: draft-inventory.txt (1 KB)
From: Taylor Nguyen <security@northbridge.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: audits@northbridge.com
Date: 2028-07-23T14:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Northbridge SOC2 evidence request - KMS/HSM artifacts

Connor — Drive link is fine. Two quick clarifications from the audit team: 
1) The auditors want an excerpt showing a rotation event where the old key was retired and a new KEK was wrapped (they don't need full tenant content — just the event and request_id). 
2) They ask for the HSM attestation certificate chain formatted as PEM if possible (many of their tools validate chain files).

If you can include those two items and mark the rotation event(s) with the event request_id in the CSV, that should be sufficient. ETA?

Thanks,
-Taylor

From: Connor Obrien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Nguyen <security@northbridge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>

Taylor — sharing the evidence bundle now. Items uploaded to the secure Drive folder (view-only): https://drive.redwood.example.com/shared/NB-SOC2/KMS-Evidence

Included artifacts (final):
- redwood-kms-rotation-log-2028-07-20.csv (rotation events flagged; request_id: RQ-78a2c)
- hsm-attestation-seal-2028-07.pdf (vendor seal)
- hsm-attestation-chain-20280724.pem (PEM chain extracted per request)
- kms-config-dump-20280720.txt (redacted aliases/policies)
- access-matrix-20280720.xlsx

Notes: 
- The rotation CSV includes an example rotation where key KEK-842 was wrapped and retired; the auditors can validate using request_id RQ-78a2c.
- We replaced tenant ARNs with <TENANT_REDACTED> and removed any raw key material.
- If your auditors need a time-ordered audit-trace (syslog + request_id correlation), we can generate a signed PDF export for chain-of-custody.

If you prefer SFTP delivery, reply with the upload endpoint and credentials and we'll push immediately.

Connor Obrien
Sr. Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
